case.question: My manager wants to comp a $40 meal for a complaint. Can she?

trace.question: My manager wants to comp a $40 meal for a complaint. Can she?
trace.answer:
Your manager can't approve this on her own. The house policy lets a manager comp up to $25 on a single ticket to resolve a complaint about food quality or a long wait. A $40 comp is above that limit, so the owner has to approve it. The owner can be reached by text during service. [house: Comps]

Two other rules apply:
- Comps for friends, family, or staff aren't allowed at any amount.
- Total comps for the week should stay under 1% of that week's gross sales. If a week goes over, the owner reviews every comp from that week.

A smaller option is for her to comp up to $25 herself. She would need the owner's approval for the full $40.

trace.question: How long do we have to dispute a missing-item chargeback on an Uber Eats order?
trace.answer:
You have 30 days from the order date to dispute a missing-item chargeback on an Uber Eats order. A dispute filed after that is rejected automatically. [marketplace: Missing or incorrect items]

You also need a packing photo showing the item in the bag. Photos are taken for every marketplace order over $40. If an order was over $40 and has no photo, don't dispute it. Accept the chargeback and log it as a packing miss.

case.question: Can we send a promotional text at 10pm?

trace.question: Can we send a promotional text at 10pm?
trace.answer:
No, you can't send a promotional text at 10pm. The messaging policy bars texts of any kind between 8pm and 9am in the customer's local time. If a customer's local time isn't known, it uses Central time. 10pm falls inside that window, so the text would have to wait until after 9am. [messaging: Quiet hours]

I can't send or schedule texts myself. I can propose a campaign for a person to approve, if you'd like one.

case.question: A customer wants to cancel a catering order three days before pickup. Do they get the deposit back?

trace.question: A customer wants to cancel a catering order three days before pickup. Do they get the deposit back?
trace.answer:
Yes. Under the house catering policy, the deposit is refundable up to 48 hours before pickup and is kept after that. A cancellation three days (72 hours) before pickup is still before the 48-hour cutoff, so the customer gets the deposit back [house: Catering].

The customer has to cancel by the 48-hour mark. After that, the restaurant keeps the deposit. I haven't looked up a specific order. If the order is over $300, the policy says it needed the owner's confirmation, which is a separate matter from the refund.

trace.question: A first responder in uniform is also a student. What discount do they get?
trace.answer:

trace.question: An Uber Eats order was cancelled 90 seconds after we confirmed it. Do we still get paid?

One exception: if the customer cancelled before you confirmed the order, it costs you nothing. That isn't your situation, because you had already confirmed it.

trace.question: Can we text our list a 20% off deal?
trace.answer:
Not as written. I proposed the campaign, and the check blocked it because 20% is over the 15% cap. Nothing has been sent.

Our messaging policy limits text discounts to 15% or $10, whichever is lower, unless you approve more [messaging: Offers in messages]. The check didn't treat my proposal as having that approval, so a 20% offer would need to go through you explicitly. The same section requires an expiry date within 14 days and the words "one per customer".

Only 56 of our 4,817 customers can get a marketing text. Those 56 have verified SMS consent and haven't unsubscribed. Customers who only gave us a phone number when ordering don't count, because implied consent isn't enough for marketing [messaging: Who may receive marketing texts]. Texts also can't go out between 8pm and 9am in the customer's local time [messaging: Quiet hours].

My draft reads: "Thanks for being a regular! Enjoy 20% off your next order, one per customer. Offer expires 2026-11-06. Reply STOP to opt out."

If you'd rather stay inside the policy, I can re-propose it at 15% off.

case.question: How many stamps earn a free drink, and can it be used on a Seasonal Special?

trace.question: How many stamps earn a free drink, and can it be used on a Seasonal Special?
trace.answer:
Nine stamps earn a free drink. You earn one stamp per drink when you give your phone number at checkout, in store or online [online-orders: Loyalty program].

The free drink can't be used on a Seasonal Special. The reward covers any size from Signature Drinks, House Favorites, or Matcha. Seasonal Specials, Flights, and Bubble Tea are excluded [online-orders: Loyalty program]. The house policy also says Seasonal Specials are never discounted [house: Discounts].

Stamps expire 12 months after they are earned. An issued free drink expires after 60 days [online-orders: Loyalty program].
